name: purchase_order_total_before_landing
rule: docs/features.md §1, Purchase: the new-purchase form shows what the order comes to before it is saved, so a slip of ten (100 cafés typed for 10) is visible. It is every line's value, unit_cost x qty_milli / 1000 rounded once to the centime half away from zero (the line_total_fractional_qty rule, the same rounding the core's checked_mul_milli gives the order's value), plus transport, plus the other costs. It is the figure before the landed cost is spread and floored per unit, so the saved order's total can come out a few centimes under it and never above. Amounts are integer centimes. Expected values are written by hand, never computed.

cases.name: an order with no line and no cost is nothing
a line worth nothing adds nothing, and costs that do not divide evenly are added whole
a half centime on a weighed line rounds away from zero
two weighed lines round once each and are then added, never rounded again
a hundred cafes typed for ten reads ten times the order

js_overflow_cases.name: one centime past Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER is refused, not rounded (the JS edge; the core's is i64)
